notes.title: 2021-07-06 Difficulty System Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Difficulty System[/h1]
The difficulty system is divided into four levels: Simple, Hard, Crazy, and Nightmare.
For maps of different levels, the probability of the appearance of elite monsters and enhanced monsters will be different.

[h2]Elite Monster[/h2]
Elite monsters increase their health by 300%, increase their damage by 75%, and have one of the following four auras:

[list]
[*]Life Aura: HP increased by 100%[/*]
[*]Damage Aura: Increases damage caused by 20%[/*]
[*]Move Speed Aura: Move Speed increased by 50%[/*]
[*]Damage Reduction Aura: Damage taken is reduced by 20%[/*]
[/list]
[h2]Enhanced Monster[/h2]
Enhanced monsters will choose an additional effect from the followings:

[list]
[*]Death Explosion: After death, it will cause 10/15/20/25/30 damage to enemy units in the area.[/*]
[*]Death Aid: After death, restore 10/15/20/25/30 HP to friendly units in the area.[/*]
[*]Death Shot: Fire bullets with damage of 10/15/20/25/30 in eight directions after death.[/*]
[*]Injury Resistance: Resist the first two injuries[/*]
[*]Unable to Smash: The damage received will not exceed 25% of the maximum HP.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*]POISON(2): Abnormal duration fixed.[/*]
[*]POISON(4): Abnormal extra properties fixed.[/*]
[*]Cross: Abnormal extra ATK fixed.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: 2021-05-01 Room Mechanism and Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Room Mechanism[/h1]
In the new version, 7 traps/triggers have been added to the room, and use the new room mechanism to redo the maps of all areas.

[h2]Spike Trap[/h2]
[b]Any unit[/b] will activate the trap after stepping on it, and the trap will cause damage to [b]all units[/b] above it after 1 second. According to the regional pollution level, the damage caused is 10/15/20/25/30.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40009331/ff2bb028ced95888aabd7de92074aef91e522387.gif[/img]

[h2]Arrow Trap[/h2]
After [b]any unit[/b] steps on the trigger, it will shoot an arrow from the corresponding launcher, causing damage to the [b]first unit[/b] it touches. According to the regional pollution level, the damage caused is 10/15/20/25/30.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40009331/d676e8ef1afabc94f9113b1bb6240fed22cd9bf0.gif[/img]

[h2]Bomb Trap[/h2]
After [b]any unit[/b] steps on the trigger, it will shoot a bomb from the corresponding launcher with a random speed, and after a delay of 2 seconds, it will cause explosion damage to [b]all units[/b] in a small area. According to the regional pollution level, the damage caused is 10/15/20/25/30.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40009331/a0b8b7eaf20dd560d6c0590848bebf7366c075d3.gif[/img]

[h2]Flame Trigger[/h2]
The launcher will continue to spray flames, causing damage to [b]any unit[/b] it touches. After the [b]player[/b] steps on the trigger, the launcher will stop spraying flames. According to the regional pollution level, the damage caused is 10/15/20/25/30.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40009331/69ab393fce7898573578f102445e23a3ef17ee97.gif[/img]

[h2]Dancing Trigger[/h2]
After the [b]player[/b] steps on the trigger, the movement speed of [b]all existing units[/b] in the room is increased by 100, which can be superimposed. The effect of a single trigger lasts for 15 seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40009331/c5c0994ec1ae2f6dd9fd19bc3a756a088c12dc0d.gif[/img]

[h2]Obstacle Trigger[/h2]
After the [b]player[/b] steps on the trigger, [b]some obstacles[/b] will change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40009331/f12fdd37e3112acff5b7853d11256a2bf6ff78ce.gif[/img]

[h2]Pass Trigger[/h2]
After the [b]player[/b] steps on the trigger, he/she passes through the current room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40009331/70f8a3dc83ac3c772d79e153898ddd3177b71f77.gif[/img]
